# Maui Youth Sports

> The community source for youth sports in Maui County, Hawaiʻi (Maui, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi): where to sign up, who to contact, schedules, scores and scholarships for keiki and teens.

## Main sections
- [Sports directory](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/sports-directory/): clubs, leagues, schools and programs by sport, with contact details
- [Scores](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/scores/): recent Maui Interscholastic League and community results
- [Schedules](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/schedules/): upcoming games, meets and events
- [Scholarships](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/scholarships/): scholarships and financial help for young athletes
- [Highlights](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/highlights/): local youth sports stories
- [Submit](https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/submit/): send scores, events or program updates

## Notes
- Program details come from each organization's own public information. Contact the program directly before registering.
- Contact Maui Youth Sports: https://maui-youth-sports.mauiyouthsports.workers.dev/contact/
